title: Algebraic reduction of supplied consecutive constant quotient models
statement: Let g:Y→X be any scheme map, d an adic coefficient datum on A [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], M an AdicTower on X [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower], and n≥0. Put C=AdicCompletion(I,A), J=IC. Let W→Y be etale and choose a point w of W. Let E′∈D(C/J^(n+2)), E∈D(C/J^(n+1)), and suppose their specified constantAdicQuotientRealization objects on W are respectively isomorphic to the actual pulled-back levels M_(n+1) and M_n [lem-weil-pbc-constant-adic-quotient-scalar-comparison]. Then there is t:E′→Res(E) for the canonical consecutive quotient map, such that for every N∈D(C/J^(n+1)), k↦t≫Res(k) is a bijection from Hom(E,N) to Hom(E′,Res(N)) [def-weil-pbc-derived-normalization-arrows]. No boundedness, perfectness, lissity, descent, connectedness or cover is assumed.

source.place: Tag 09C6, consecutive quotient balancing; Tags 0D6D and 03Q3

proof.text: Apply exact inverse image along W.hom≫g to the given tower normalization between M_(n+1) and M_n. The canonical tensor-pullback comparison identifies it with the reduction along the pulled-back actual coefficient projection. Substitute the two supplied constant model isomorphisms.

The completion quotient maps commute with the consecutive quotient maps, checked on representatives. Canonical constant-realization scalar comparison identifies reduction of the first constant model with constant realization of its algebraic derived reduction. Thus this algebraic reduction and E have isomorphic constant realizations on W.

Apply the exact geometric inverse image at an algebraic closure point over w. Constant-stalk comparison and tensor-pullback identify the resulting isomorphism with an algebraic derived reduction isomorphism. Transpose under extension/restriction adjunction to get t. Composition with the isomorphism and the adjunction Hom equivalence gives precisely the required Hom bijections.

theorem constantAdicQuotient_model_reduction
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (g : Y ⟶ X)
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    (M : AdicTower X d) (n : ℕ) (W : Y.Etale) (_w : W.left)
    (E' : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (AdicCompletion d.ideal A ⧸
      (d.ideal.map (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion d.ideal A))) ^ (n + 1 + 1))))
    (E : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (AdicCompletion d.ideal A ⧸
      (d.ideal.map (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion d.ideal A))) ^ (n + 1))))
    (e' : Nonempty ((constantAdicQuotientRealization (W.hom ≫ g) d (n + 1)).obj E' ≅
      (adicTowerPullback (W.hom ≫ g)
        ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op (n + 1)))).obj (M.level (n + 1))))
    (e : Nonempty ((constantAdicQuotientRealization (W.hom ≫ g) d n).obj E ≅
      (adicTowerPullback (W.hom ≫ g)
        ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))).obj (M.level n))) :
    ∃ t : E' ⟶
      (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u + 1, u + 1, u + 1} (Ideal.Quotient.factor
        (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (I := d.ideal.map
          (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion d.ideal A)))
          (Nat.le_succ (n + 1))))).mapDerivedCategory.obj E,
      ∀ N : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (AdicCompletion d.ideal A ⧸
        (d.ideal.map (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion d.ideal A))) ^ (n + 1))),
        Function.Bijective (fun k : E ⟶ N ↦ t ≫
          (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u + 1, u + 1, u + 1} (Ideal.Quotient.factor
            (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (I := d.ideal.map
              (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion d.ideal A)))
              (Nat.le_succ (n + 1))))).mapDerivedCategory.map k)
